summary_en: FY3/27 annual dividend forecast raised to ¥144/share (+¥4 from prior forecast to interim of ¥72/share, +¥6 vs. FY3/26 actual ¥138/share). H1 FY3/27 sales, operating profit, ordinary profit, and net income to parent all hit record highs.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase) for FY3/27
translation_en_brief: On 4 August 2026, Aica Kogyo announced a revision to its FY3/27 (year ending 31 March 2027) dividend forecast. The annual dividend per share is being raised to ¥144, up ¥4 from the prior forecast of ¥140 and ¥6 above the prior year's actual payout of ¥138. The interim dividend (second quarter) is being lifted from the previously forecast ¥68 to ¥72, while the year-end dividend remains ¥72. The board cited strong first-quarter cumulative results across all key metrics—sales, operating profit, ordinary profit, and net income attributable to parent—as reaching record highs. The company operates under a medium-term management plan emphasizing progressive dividend policy without cuts, balancing shareholder returns, capital efficiency, and financial soundness.
